title: Synergistic MgSiO(3) nanocatalysis for the efficient synthesis of benzo[d]oxazol-2-yl phenylisoxazoles: structural elucidation, drug-likeness profiling, and target-oriented biomolecular interactions.
authors: Smitha, A K; Murthy, V Srinivasa; Sennappan, M; Vinay Kumar, B; Shridhar, A H; Naik, Lohit; Ravi Kumar, K; Yogendra, K; Madhusudhana, N
one_liner_zh: 该文研究苯并噁唑-异噁唑衍生物与小牛胸腺DNA的嵌插结合，采用光谱实验和分子对接，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作（实为小分子-DNA）且方法含对接，但非TF-DNA体系，可借鉴其对接与电子结构分析思路。
abstract: A new library of 2-(5-phenylisoxazole-3-yl)benzo[d]oxazole derivatives 3(a-f) was synthesized through a magnesium silicate nanocatalyst-assisted condensation of 2-aminophenol with a series of substituted 5-phenylisoxazole-3-carbaldehydes. The identity of the products was confirmed by FT-IR, (1)H NMR, (13)C NMR, and mass spectrometry. Their interaction with calf thymus DNA (CT-DNA) was systematically examined using absorption spectroscopy, viscosity assays, thermal denaturation experiments, and molecular docking simulations. The compounds exhibited binding constants in the 10(5)-10(6) M(-1) range, with 3d showing the strongest affinity (K(b) = 1.13 x 10(6) M(-1)), consistent with an intercalative binding mode. Docking studies with human DNA (PDB ID: 1G3X) revealed stabilizing hydrogen bonds, pi-pi stacking, and hydrophobic contacts that corroborated the experimental findings. Electronic properties were further explored through density functional theory calculations at the B3LYP level, which demonstrated that frontier orbital parameters-particularly highest occupied molecular orbital-lowest unoccupied molecular orbital gaps and electrophilicity indices-correlated well with DNA-binding behavior, offering mechanistic insight into the electronic contributions to molecular recognition. In silico Absorption, Distribution, Metabolism, Excretion, and Toxicity (ADMET) profiling suggested favorable pharmacokinetic attributes and drug-like properties. All derivatives promoted UV-induced cleavage of supercoiled pBR322 DNA, underscoring their potential as photoactive nuclease mimetics. These results identify benzoxazole-isoxazole hybrids as promising scaffolds for DNA-targeted applications in medicinal chemistry and chemical biology.
abstract_zh: 通过硅酸镁纳米催化剂辅助2-氨基苯酚与一系列取代的5-苯基异噁唑-3-甲醛缩合，合成了一类新的2-(5-苯基异噁唑-3-基)苯并[d]噁唑衍生物3(a-f)。产物结构通过FT-IR、¹H NMR、¹³C NMR和质谱确认。利用吸收光谱、粘度测定、热变性实验和分子对接模拟，系统研究了它们与小牛胸腺DNA (CT-DNA)的相互作用。这些化合物表现出10⁵-10⁶ M⁻¹范围内的结合常数，其中3d显示出最强亲和力（K_b = 1.13 × 10⁶ M⁻¹），与嵌入结合模式一致。与人DNA（PDB ID: 1G3X）的对接研究揭示了稳定的氢键、π-π堆积和疏水接触，验证了实验发现。通过B3LYP水平的密度泛函理论计算进一步探索了电子性质，结果表明前沿轨道参数——特别是最高占据分子轨道-最低未占据分子轨道能隙和亲电性指数——与DNA结合行为相关，为分子识别中的电子贡献提供了机制性见解。计算机模拟吸收、分布、代谢、排泄和毒性（ADMET）分析提示了良好的药代动力学特性和类药性质。所有衍生物均促进紫外线诱导的超螺旋pBR322 DNA切割，凸显了它们作为光活性核酸酶模拟物的潜力。这些结果将苯并噁唑-异噁唑杂合体确定为药物化学和化学生物学中DNA靶向应用的有前景骨架。
